They do best with a base color, especially black to really set them off and then you only need to use one coat of these special polishes. The bottles are smaller then expected, but the product looks beautiful and the cat eye look with the use of a magnet is pretty.

reviews.t: Great variety set of magnetic multichrome polishes
reviews.x: This set comes with 6 polishes, all different colors of multichrome shifts. The shade names are Fairbanks Art, Lightning, Greenland Night, Aurora Borealis, The Gravity, and Astral Realm. I applied all of the polishes onto clear nail swatch sticks. I started with an opaque black base and did two coats of each of the polishes. I used a magnet I got from Born Pretty store over each of the coats. Afterwards I applied a topcoat and held the magnet over the topcoat for ~30 seconds per the instructions

claims.text: Reviewers consistently describe the polishes as gorgeous and beautiful, especially the multichrome and cat-eye effects.
Many reviewers note the polishes work best over a black base coat, which makes the effects pop and reduces the number of coats needed.
Several reviewers mention it takes some practice to get the magnet effect right, especially for beginners.
Some reviewers point out that a magnet is not included and must be purchased or found separately.
A few reviewers mention the bottles are smaller than expected or that the colors received differed from what was advertised.
